---
title: "Exploratory Data Analysis"
subtitle: "Trade Winds & Headwinds — USVI Tourism Economy, 2000–2025"
---

This companion to the [main publication](index.qmd) documents the full exploratory analysis.
All charts are generated from the cleaned datasets in `data/interim/`.
The complete analytical notebooks — including detailed tables, validation checks,
and additional charts — are in the `notebooks/` directory.

::: {.callout-note}
**No CPI deflation.** All monetary series are nominal USD.
Real-dollar comparisons use BEA's own chained-dollar measures (Table 2.3).
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import os

PROJ_ROOT = Path("..").resolve()
if str(PROJ_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJ_ROOT))
os.chdir(PROJ_ROOT)

import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import src.cleaning as c, src.charts as ch
import importlib
importlib.reload(c); importlib.reload(ch)

from src.cleaning import (
    load_usviber_combined, load_fred_employment,
    load_bea, load_nps_annual, load_nps_monthly,
    load_census_2007, load_census_2012_basic,
    load_census_2017_basic, load_census_2022_basic,
    load_census_rooms,
)
from src.charts import PALETTE

tour     = load_usviber_combined()
fred     = load_fred_employment()
bea_real = load_bea("2.3")
bea_nom  = load_bea("2.1")
bea_gdp  = load_bea("1.1")
viis_ann = load_nps_annual("VIIS")
buis_ann = load_nps_annual("BUIS")
viis_mo  = load_nps_monthly("VIIS")
rooms    = load_census_rooms()

c07 = load_census_2007()
c12 = load_census_2012_basic()
c17 = load_census_2017_basic()
c22 = load_census_2022_basic()

fred_ann = (
    fred.groupby("year")["emp_sa"].mean()
    .reset_index().rename(columns={"emp_sa": "emp_sa_avg"})
)

frames = []
for df, v in [(c07,2007),(c12,2012),(c17,2017),(c22,2022)]:
    sub = df[df["naics"].astype(str).isin(["72","721","722"])].copy()
    sub["vintage"] = v
    frames.append(sub)
census = pd.concat(frames).drop_duplicates(subset=["year","naics"]).sort_values(["naics","year"])

af_real = (
    bea_real[bea_real["label"].str.contains("ccommodation", case=False, na=False)]
    .drop_duplicates(subset="year")[["year", "value"]]
    .rename(columns={"value": "af_real"})
)

BASE = 2016

def _index(df, year_col, val_col, base=BASE):
    bv = df.loc[df[year_col] == base, val_col]
    if bv.empty or bv.values[0] == 0:
        return None
    base_val = bv.values[0]
    out = df[[year_col, val_col]].copy()
    out["idx"] = out[val_col] / base_val * 100
    return out
```

## Section 1 — Visitor Activity

### Total arrivals and visitor composition

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-eda-arrivals
#| fig-cap: "Air visitors (all USVI arrivals by air) versus cruise passengers. Total visitors shown as context. 2001–2009 from USVIBER 2010 publication."

fig = go.Figure()
for col, name, color, dash, lw, op in [
    ("air_visitors",     "Air visitors",     PALETTE["air_visitors"], "solid", 2.4, 1.0),
    ("cruise_passengers","Cruise passengers", PALETTE["cruise"],       "solid", 2.4, 1.0),
    ("total_visitors",   "Total visitors",   PALETTE["total"],        "dash",  1.4, 0.55),
]:
    sub = tour[["year", col]].dropna()
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=sub["year"], y=sub[col],
        mode="lines", name=name, opacity=op,
        line=dict(color=color, width=lw, dash=dash),
    ))

fig.update_layout(
    title=dict(text="<b>Air Visitors vs. Cruise Passengers</b>", font=dict(size=16), x=0.0),
    yaxis_title="Visitors (thousands)",
    height=400,
    annotations=[ch.source_note(
        "USVIBER Annual Tourism Indicator 2024; 2001–2009 from USVIBER 2010"
    )],
)
ch.add_shocks(fig).show()
```

### Census guestroom capacity

| Year | Guestrooms | Establishments | Reported receipts (thousands USD) | Measurement basis |
|------|-----------:|-----------:|---------------:|------------------|
| 2007 | 4,065 | 47 | $308,481 | A10 accommodation-industry total |
| 2012 | 5,027 | 54 | $319,049 | A10 accommodation-industry total |
| 2017 | 2,624 | 46 | $237,838 | NAPCS02 product 7003825000 |
| 2022 | 2,039 | 51 | $135,204 | NAPCS02 product 7003825000 |

Guestroom counts come from the Census Bureau's Economic Census. The 2007 and 2012 figures use accommodation-industry totals (A10); 2017 and 2022 use NAPCS02 product code 7003825000, covering room or unit accommodation for travelers. These are the closest available measures across the four census years, but the change in measurement basis means they are not a perfectly consistent time series. The 2017 count is dated December 31, after Hurricanes Irma and Maria, and represents post-hurricane capacity.

## Section 4 — Economic Context

### Accommodation & food services value added

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-bea-va

def _get(df, pattern):
    return (df[df["label"].str.contains(pattern, case=False, na=False)]
              .drop_duplicates(subset="year").sort_values("year"))

af_nom_s  = _get(bea_nom,  "Accommodation")
af_real_s = _get(bea_real, "Accommodation")
gdp_nom_s = _get(bea_gdp,  "Gross domestic")

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=af_nom_s["year"], y=af_nom_s["value"],
    mode="lines", name="Nominal value added<br>(current USD)",
    line=dict(color=PALETTE["value_added"], width=2.5), marker=dict(size=4)))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=af_real_s["year"], y=af_real_s["value"],
    mode="lines", name="Real value added<br>(chained 2012 USD)",
    line=dict(color=PALETTE["cruise"], width=2.5, dash="dash"), marker=dict(size=4)))
fig.update_layout(title="A&F Value Added (BEA)",
    yaxis=dict(title="Value added (millions)<br>Nominal and chained 2012 USD",
    tickprefix="$", separatethousands=True), height=420,
    margin=dict(l=60,r=30,t=60,b=50),
    annotations=[ch.source_note("BEA USVI GDP data. Coverage ends 2021. A&F ≠ tourism GDP. Nominal values are measured in current dollars. Real values are inflation-adjusted and expressed in chained 2012 dollars.")])
ch.add_shocks(fig).show()
```

## Section 5 — Recovery Comparisons

### Full recovery index (2016 = 100)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-eda-index

all_series = {
    "Air visitors":          _index(tour, "year", "air_visitors"),
    "Cruise passengers":     _index(tour, "year", "cruise_passengers"),
    "Total arrivals":        _index(tour, "year", "total_visitors"),
    "Overnight tourists":    _index(tour, "year", "tourists"),
    "Hotel rooms":           _index(tour, "year", "hotel_rooms"),
    "L&H employment":        _index(fred_ann, "year", "emp_sa_avg"),
    "A&F real VA (–2021)":   _index(af_real_s, "year", "value"),
    "VIIS NP visits":        _index(viis_ann.query("year>=2000"), "year", "recreation_visitors"),
}
styles = {
    "Air visitors":        (PALETTE["air_visitors"], "solid",    2.5),
    "Cruise passengers":   (PALETTE["cruise"],       "solid",    2.5),
    "Total arrivals":      (PALETTE["total"],        "dash",     1.5),
    "Overnight tourists":  (PALETTE["tourists"],     "dot",      1.5),
    "Hotel rooms":         (PALETTE["rooms"],        "dot",      1.5),
    "L&H employment":      (PALETTE["employment"],   "longdash", 1.5),
    "A&F real VA (–2021)": (PALETTE["value_added"],  "dash",     1.5),
    "VIIS NP visits":      (PALETTE["nps_viis"],     "dashdot",  1.5),
}

fig = go.Figure()
for name, df in all_series.items():
    if df is None: continue
    color, dash, width = styles[name]
    sub = df[["year","idx"]].dropna()
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=sub["year"], y=sub["idx"],
        mode="lines", name=name,
        line=dict(color=color, dash=dash, width=width)))
fig.add_hline(y=100, line=dict(color="#ccc", width=1, dash="dot"),
    annotation_text="2016 = 100", annotation_position="right",
    annotation_font=dict(size=10, color="#999"))
fig.update_layout(title="Recovery Index (2016 = 100)",
    xaxis=dict(range=[2000, tour["year"].max()]),
    yaxis_title="Index (2016 = 100)", height=520,
    plot_bgcolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.85)", font=dict(size=11),
    margin=dict(l=60,r=30,t=65,b=125),
    annotations=[ch.source_note("USVIBER, FRED, BEA, NPS IRMA — author calculations")])
ch.add_shocks(fig).show()
```

### Recovery scorecard

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-eda-scorecard
#| fig-cap: "Recovery scorecard. Air visitors and cruise passengers use their palette colours; all other series use green (at or above 2016 baseline) or blue-grey (below baseline). Year in parentheses is the latest available observation for each series."

latest_map = {
    "Total arrivals":    ("2024", _index(tour, "year", "total_visitors")),
    "Air visitors":      ("2024", _index(tour, "year", "air_visitors")),
    "Cruise passengers": ("2024", _index(tour, "year", "cruise_passengers")),
    "Hotel rooms":       ("2024", _index(tour, "year", "hotel_rooms")),
    "L&H employment":    ("2025", _index(fred_ann, "year", "emp_sa_avg")),
    "A&F real VA":       ("2021", _index(af_real, "year", "af_real")),
    "VIIS NP visits":    ("2025", _index(viis_ann.query("year>=2000"), "year", "recreation_visitors")),
}

def _bar_color(name, value):
    if name == "Air visitors":      return PALETTE["air_visitors"]
    if name == "Cruise passengers": return PALETTE["cruise"]
    return PALETTE["above_baseline"] if value >= 100 else PALETTE["below_baseline"]

rows = []
for name, (yr_str, df) in latest_map.items():
    if df is None: continue
    row = df[df["year"] == int(yr_str)]
    if row.empty: continue
    rows.append((name, yr_str, round(row["idx"].values[0], 1)))

rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[2])   # ascending: highest value at top of horizontal chart
labels = [f"{r[0]} ({r[1]})" for r in rows]
values = [r[2] for r in rows]
colors = [_bar_color(r[0], r[2]) for r in rows]

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=values, y=labels,
    orientation="h",
    marker_color=colors,
    text=[f"{v:.0f}" for v in values],
    textposition="outside",
    textfont=dict(size=11),
    cliponaxis=False,
))
fig.add_vline(
    x=100,
    line=dict(color="#555", width=1.2),
    annotation_text="2016 = 100",
    annotation_position="top",
    annotation_font=dict(size=9, color="#777"),
)
fig.update_layout(
    title=dict(text="<b>Recovery Scorecard</b>", font=dict(size=16), x=0.0),
    xaxis=dict(
        title="Index (2016 = 100)",
        range=[0, max(values) * 1.14],
        showgrid=True, gridcolor="#eeeeee",
    ),
    yaxis=dict(tickfont=dict(size=11)),
    height=360,
    showlegend=False,
    margin=dict(l=180, r=56, t=52, b=56),
    annotations=[ch.source_note(
        "USVIBER, FRED, BEA, NPS IRMA — author calculations", y=-0.12
    )],
)
fig.show()
```
